articles.title_en: Russia’s budget deficit reached 2.5% of GDP since the start of the year. Kremlin says that’s no cause for concern.
articles.lead_en: Russia’s federal budget deficit reached 5.8 trillion rubles, or 2.5% of GDP, over the first eight months of 2026, according to a preliminary estimate from the Finance Ministry, one and a half times more than in the same period last year. Authorities had projected a full-year deficit of just 3.8 trillion rubles, or 1.6% of GDP.
